verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own install docs offer building 'from source', and community reports mention active GitHub contributors and running the core engine (Milli) locally. Together these imply the source is publicly readable, but no evidence names or describes an open license. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. MIT/OSI terms), first-party docs linking the source repository, clarity on which components (engine vs. cloud/enterprise features) are open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.
They praised active contributors on GitHub and Discord.
A user runs the core engine (Milli) as a local indexer over their repositories and Obsidian files
